import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts(dropna=True).reset_index()
breed_counts.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']
top_10 = breed_counts.nlargest(10, 'Count')
other_count = breed_counts.iloc[10:]['Count'].sum()
top_10 = pd.concat([
    top_10,
    pd.DataFrame({'Breed': ['Other'], 'Count': [other_count]})
], ignore_index=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=top_10, x='Count', y='Breed', palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich Registrations')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
